items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: we had, uh, how do you call him, uh, Morgan, Andrew Morgan

ctx.x: Who Struck John? Did you ever hear that? Who? Who Struck John? Yeah. A friend of mine used to go up and listen to Joe, I hope I need to ask him the name of a number, he'd say, Who Struck John? Yeah. He'd ask him the name of the next number, he'd say, Who Struck John?

Now we had a fellow, who when, most of the time them leaders used to buy so much music, they'd have a briefcase, so full, that it'd have to thin it out, it'd have so much music, some of them old numbers that they wasn't playing, you know, I didn't finish playing for them, it wasn't using them, just clean it out, thin it out, put some new numbers in there. We had, when I was playing at Mama Lou, with Andrew Jefferson, and Raymond Glabion, was playing guitar, Raymond had a briefcase, so full of music, couldn't…
What about, when did you have Herb Moran?
